about_page.title: About Us
about_page.hero_desc: ComentsIA is the leading platform in online review intelligence and management. We combine cutting-edge Artificial Intelligence with humanized customer care workflows so your company strengthens local authority, delights customers, and maximizes sales conversion.
about_page.section_pillars_title: How we transform your online reputation
about_page.section_pillars_desc: Technology designed to simplify every stage of post-sale customer relationship.
about_page.pillar_1_desc: Official synchronization with Google Business Profile APIs. All reviews from all your locations unified into a single organized queue.
about_page.pillar_2_desc: AI trained to generate empathetic, polite replies aligned with your brand voice in 1 click. Customize greetings, signatures, and support contacts.
about_page.pillar_3_desc: Real-time dashboards with average ratings, reply rates, sentiment analysis, and executive PDF reports ready to share with executives.
about_page.diff_1_desc: Natural and tailored replies adapted according to the rating received (1 to 5 stars).
about_page.diff_2_desc: Individual control per store or consolidated view in the Headquarters Panel.
about_page.diff_3_desc: Elegant PDF documents formatted for executive board meetings.
about_page.diff_4_desc: Strict adherence to Google API guidelines and data privacy regulations.
about_page.diff_5_desc: Up to 80% reduction in time spent keeping 100% of customer reviews answered.
about_page.mission_desc: Our mission is to eliminate repetitive tasks and turn every customer review into a real opportunity for growth, retention, and revenue.
about_page.how_it_works_desc: Start operating in less than 2 minutes.
about_page.security_point_desc: Your data is never sold. The platform uses official Google OAuth 2.0 secure authentication and encryption at rest.
about_page.step1_desc: Log in with your Google account and select the locations you want to monitor.
about_page.step2_desc: Set the tone of voice (friendly, formal, etc.), manager name, and contact channels.
about_page.step3_desc: Generate replies with 1 click, publish directly and watch your score rise.
about_page.cta_desc: Join companies that already save time and boost their Google score.
